mutant.lineText: export const splitList = (s: string): string[] => { const out: string[] = []; let cur = ''; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { if (s[i] === '\\' && i + 1 < s.length) { cur += s[i]! + s[++i]!; } else if (s[i] === ',') { out.push(cur); cur = ''; } else cur += s[i]; } out.push(cur); return out; };
